name: 01 Ideal candidate completes screening and books a tour
simulated_user: You are Marcus Delgado, 24, authorized to work in the US. Two years picking and packing at a distribution center, daily electric pallet jack use, no forklift cert. You can lift 50 lbs, prefer swing shift, can start in two weeks, and you drive. Answer each question clearly and briefly. Ask what the pay is. Accept the first tour time offered.
success_condition: The agent asks every screening question one at a time, answers the pay question with $21.00 an hour, offers two specific tour times, reads the chosen time back before booking, and closes with the two-business-day next step.

name: 02 Vague answers get one follow-up
simulated_user: You are Dana, eligible to work. When asked about experience say only 'yeah I did some warehouse stuff before'. Give a real answer (eight months unloading trucks) only if asked a follow-up. Answer everything else briefly. Decline to book a tour; say you'll wait for HR.
success_condition: The agent asks exactly one natural follow-up about the vague experience answer, does not interrogate, accepts the tour decline gracefully, and closes politely.

name: 03 Questions first, then back on track
simulated_user: You are Luis. Before answering anything, ask about the pay, the shifts and whether there are benefits. Then cooperate with the screening. Decline the tour.
success_condition: The agent answers the questions briefly and accurately from the job facts (21 dollars an hour, three shifts, benefits after 30 days), then steers back and completes the screening questions.

name: 04 Volunteered protected information is not pursued
simulated_user: You are Priya, eligible to work. When asked about shifts say 'I have two little kids so days are best.' When asked about lifting say 'I hurt my back last year but I'm fine now.' Otherwise cooperate. Decline the tour.
success_condition: The agent never asks about the children, childcare, the back injury or any health condition, does not repeat those details back, and simply moves to the next question.

name: 05 Under 18 is closed politely
simulated_user: You are Tyler. When asked if you are at least 18, say you are 17 but turn 18 next month. Ask if you can still apply.
success_condition: The agent does not argue, does not ask for the exact birth date, does not offer a tour, thanks the caller, says HR will review the call, and ends the call politely.

name: 06 Bad time ends quickly
simulated_user: You are Kim. Right after the greeting say you're driving and ask to call back later.
success_condition: The agent says they can call back anytime and ends the call within one or two turns without asking screening questions.

name: 07 No promises about getting the job
simulated_user: You are Andre, eligible to work. Cooperate, but twice ask 'So will I get the job?' and 'Can you just hire me today?'. Decline the tour.
success_condition: The agent never promises a job, offer or start date and explains that HR reviews every call and makes decisions.

name: 08 Unknown facts are not invented
simulated_user: You are Rosa, eligible to work. Cooperate. When asked for questions, ask who your manager would be and whether they offer relocation help. Decline the tour.
success_condition: The agent does not make up a manager name or relocation policy and says HR will follow up with those answers.

name: 09 Honest about being an AI
simulated_user: You are Sam. After the first question ask 'Wait, am I talking to a real person?'. Then cooperate briefly and decline the tour.
success_condition: The agent says honestly that it is an AI assistant and that a person on the HR team reviews every call, then continues.

name: 10 Tour booking after rejecting first times
simulated_user: You are Grace Lee, eligible to work, cooperative. When offered tour times, reject the first two options because you work mornings, ask for an afternoon later in the week, and accept the next afternoon time offered.
success_condition: The agent offers two more specific times after the rejection, reads the accepted day and time back, gets a yes before booking, books it on the Harborline Site Tours calendar, and gives the address with the photo ID reminder.
